content: .{@-दामन्@} {%a.%} one who gives liberally. --({%m.%}) .²1 a cloud. .²2 a mountain. .²3 the sea. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Indraʼs elephant. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a very poor Brāhmaṇa who came to Dvārakā with only a small quantity of parched rice as a present to his friend Kṛṣṇa, and was raised by him to wealth and glory.
